nodes.label: Shannon Entropy
nodes.rationale: Higher entropy of softmax/sigmoid output means less confident prediction; max is log_b n (1 bit for binary).

nodes.label: max_lines Hyperparameter
nodes.rationale: Reusable config knob that works for local_file and url corpora, cuts the outer skip-gram loop directly, and avoids rebuilding the corpus file.

nodes.label: Skip-gram Preprocessing Bottleneck (generate_training_data)
nodes.rationale: The tqdm progress (32777/120000) is the Python loop over sequences with per-pair negative sampling before model.fit; epochs=1 does not shorten it.

nodes.label: Speed/Quality Config Presets (fast debug, balanced, higher quality)
nodes.norm_label: speed/quality config presets (fast debug, balanced, higher quality)
nodes.rationale: Knobs ranked by quality impact: min_line_length and num_negative_samples least harmful; window_size, sequence_length, vocab_size more harmful (window_size especially for news).

nodes.label: Stochastic Variance
nodes.rationale: Run-to-run noise from weight init, shuffle order, stochastic layers and nondeterministic GPU kernels; observed accuracy delta mainly from epochs 8 vs 10 plus this noise.

nodes.label: Threshold Analysis (0.10-0.90 decision cutoff sweep)
nodes.rationale: Fixed 0.5 threshold is not always optimal; picking the max-F1 threshold balances precision and recall per embedding.

nodes.label: Vocabulary Ordering Alignment
nodes.rationale: Embedding rows are tied to vectorizer token indices; reuse the same vocab or weights misalign with words.

nodes.label: Frozen Embedding Fair Comparison
nodes.rationale: Keep identical splits, classifier head and training settings, and freeze embeddings so the comparison measures embedding quality rather than fine-tuning behavior.

nodes.label: Stale Cache Pitfall (_segment.cache_clear)
nodes.rationale: Changing the scoring function without re-running the cached definition leaves stale memoized results.

nodes.label: _segment with functools.lru_cache memoization
nodes.rationale: Original recursion recomputed the same suffixes repeatedly; lru_cache avoids recomputation. Tuples used because cached values should be immutable; public wrapper still returns a list.

nodes.label: Length-sensitive Unknown-Word Penalty
nodes.rationale: With a flat 1/gramCount fallback, one long unknown token incurs a single penalty and beats a 9-word split; penalizing by 10**len(word) makes long unknown strings unattractive so 'thequickbrownfox...' splits correctly.
